summary: 无人机导航诱骗设备通过发射模拟卫星导航信号，改变目标无人机导航控制系统定位信息，诱导目标做出错误响应，使其按指定方向远离警戒区，或使其误判而就近迫降，或被诱导至指定区域。 通过部署该设备，形成以设备为中心的半球形管控区域。在管控区域外无人机无法进入，能对抗无人机集群。
summary_en: The UAV navigation spoofing system emits simulated satellite navigation signals to alter the target drone's positioning data, inducing erroneous responses. This forces the drone to move away from restricted areas, land immediately, or follow a designated path. Deploying this device creates a hemispherical controlled zone centered on the equipment, effectively countering drone swarms and preventing unauthorized entry.
key_application: 应用领域：通过部署该设备，形成以设备为中心的半球形管控区域。在管控区域外无人机无法进入，能对抗无人机集群。；设备可单独使用，也可与低空探测雷达，无线电侦测设备和无线电干扰设备协同使用。可以移动式部署，车载式部署和固定式部署。；干扰模式多
key_application_en: Hemispherical zone defense against drone swarms; supports mobile, vehicle, or stationary deployment; versatile modes including directional repulsion, area denial, and precision capture; integrated defense with radar/RF detection.
key_parameter_2: 工作频点: GPS L1/L2、GLO L1/L2、BDS B1/B2（频点可定制）
key_parameter_2_en: Operating Frequency: GPS L1/L2, GLO L1/L2, BDS B1/B2 (Customizable)

parameters.设备定位: 设备具有GNSS定位功能并上报经纬度坐标
parameters.安装方式: 支持固定点安装、便携式安装、车载安装

parameters_en.Operating Frequency: GPS L1/L2, GLONASS L1/L2, BDS B1/B2 (Customizable)

detail_html:
功能特点

  • 建立以设备为中心的半球形防御空域，构建无人机禁入区域，从底层切断集群攻击。
  • 支持多种干扰与诱导模式：定向驱离、区域拒止、禁飞、定点诱捕与导航压制。
  • 全频点覆盖：支持GPS、GLONASS、BDS及GALILEO等全球主流卫星系统。
  • 系统集成性强：可与雷达、侦测系统自动联动实现察打一体。
  • 灵活部署：重量轻（≤10kg），支持车载、固定及单兵携带等多种作业方式。
  • Figure 1 UAV Navigation Spoofing System
detail_html_en:
Features

  • Hemispherical security zone: creates an equipment-centric airspace to deter drone swarms and prevent unauthorized incursions.
  • Advanced tactical modes: directional repulsion, area denial, no-fly zone enforcement, navigation jamming, and fixed-point capture.
  • Global GNSS support: covers GPS, GLONASS, BDS, and Galileo for multi-system compatibility.
  • Multi-level integration: works seamlessly as a standalone unit or in cooperation with low-altitude radars and RF sensors.
  • Versatile physical deployment: lightweight (≤10kg) and compact for stationary, vehicle-mounted, or portable field operations.
